bugs.title: dispatch --output paths can escape the repository root

evidence.symptom: dispatch/host_runtime --output accepted traversal such as ../escape.json or ../../escape.json and could write JSON outside the repository root; existing symlink ancestors inside the repo could also redirect output outside root.
reproSteps: Call host_runtime_list through the registry with { json: true, output: "../escape.json" } and observe the write target resolves outside the fixture repo root before this fix.

Call dispatch_plan through the registry text path with { storyId: "B-dispatch", host: "fake", output: "../../escape.json" } and observe the write target resolves outside the fixture repo root before this fix.

Call host_runtime_list with output under packages/main/src/generated/external-link where external-link is a pre-existing symlink to an external directory; before this fix the mkdir/write path could follow that ancestor outside root.
evidence.rootCause: packages/main/src/handlers/lattice-dispatch.ts resolved output with resolve(ctx.root,args.output) and wrote directly. That lexical resolve did not require the final path to stay under repo root and did not canonicalize the nearest existing parent/ancestor to reject symlink escapes. host_runtime_list/probe also bypassed the shared maybeWriteOutput helper entirely.
evidence.fixEvidence: Added a shared guarded output writer in packages/main/src/handlers/lattice-dispatch.ts. It rejects lexical traversal outside repo root, canonicalizes the nearest existing parent ancestor with realpathSync, rejects existing symlink ancestors resolving outside root, keeps new repo-local paths valid, and preserves lstat-based no-overwrite. host_runtime_list/probe now use the same writer as dispatch commands. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build; npm --prefix packages/main run test:dispatch-run-smoke; npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-ownership-contract; npm run test:process-fact-contract.
evidence.reproTest: packages/main/src/tasks/dispatch-run-smoke.ts covers host_runtime_list --output=../escape.json, dispatch_plan --output=../../escape.json, symlink ancestor escape rejection, legal repo-local output creation, and no-overwrite rejection.
